turnkey-project.title: Turnkey (EPC) Projects for Railway Workshops
turnkey-project.description: Turnkey (EPC) projects for railway wheel shops and depots: layout, civil interface, machines, installation, training and lifetime support from one partner.
turnkey-project.h1: Turnkey (EPC) Projects for wheel shops and depots
turnkey-project.lede: When a railway or metro operator needs a complete wheel shop or depot facility, HYT takes responsibility from first layout to running workshop – one contract, one schedule, one accountable partner.
turnkey-project.summary: Complete wheel shops and depot facilities, from layout and civil interface to machines, commissioning and lifetime support.

blocks.heading: One partner from empty shed to running workshop
paragraphs: A wheel shop or depot is more than a collection of machines. Wheelsets must flow from arrival to release without bottlenecks, pits and foundations must match machine designs to the millimetre, and power, compressed air and data must reach the right place at the right time. When these pieces are bought from different suppliers, the gaps between them become the client's problem.

In a turnkey – or EPC (engineering, procurement and construction) – project, HYT takes responsibility for those gaps. We study your fleet and throughput, design the process and layout, supply and integrate the machines, coordinate or execute the civil interface, and commission the complete facility on your own wheelsets.

Because we design and build the core machines ourselves, the process, the foundations and the equipment are engineered together from the start. That reduces interface risk, shortens commissioning and gives you a single point of accountability for performance.

blocks.heading: Facilities we design, equip and commission
blocks.intro: Six facility types, one approach: a single partner responsible for layout, machines, installation and lifetime support.

blocks.heading: What a turnkey wheel shop or depot project can include
blocks.intro: Every project is scoped to the client's needs. The elements below can be combined as required.

items.title: Process and layout engineering
items.text: Fleet analysis, capacity planning and a wheelset flow that avoids bottlenecks and unnecessary handling.

items.title: Civil and building interface
items.text: Pit, foundation and rail-support design, coordinated with your civil contractor or executed within our scope.

items.title: Machines
items.text: Wheel lathes, vertical turning machines, axle lathes, wheel presses, measuring stations and balancing machines.

items.title: Wheelset handling
items.text: Transfer and handling arrangements that move heavy wheelsets safely between workstations.

items.title: Utilities and integration
items.text: Power distribution, compressed air, chip handling and data connections planned as one system.

items.title: Commissioning and support
items.text: Facility-level acceptance, staff training and long-term maintenance contracts.

blocks.heading: How a turnkey project is delivered
blocks.intro: Each phase ends with a clear deliverable that you review and approve before the next begins.

items.title: Requirement study
items.text: Fleet mix, wheel and axle types, throughput targets and site constraints are analysed with your team.

items.title: Concept and layout
items.text: Process flow, machine selection and building layout are developed and agreed.

items.title: Detailed engineering
items.text: Machine designs, pit and foundation drawings, utilities and interfaces are finalised.

items.title: Manufacturing and procurement
items.text: Machines are built and tested at our works in Pune; bought-out equipment is sourced and inspected.

items.title: Site preparation
items.text: Civil works are executed or supervised, and readiness is checked before machines are shipped.

items.title: Installation and integration
items.text: Machines, handling and utilities are installed, connected and tested as a system.

items.title: Commissioning and acceptance
items.text: The facility is proven on your own wheelsets against agreed performance criteria.

items.title: Training, handover and support
items.text: Staff are trained, documentation is handed over and long-term [maintenance](page:maintenance) begins.

blocks.heading: Fewer interfaces, less risk, earlier output
paragraphs: Most delays in workshop projects happen at interfaces: a pit that does not match the machine, a power supply that arrives late, a handling system that cannot reach a workstation. A single turnkey partner designs those interfaces out before construction begins.

For [railways](page:ind-railways), [metros](page:ind-metros) and [rolling stock manufacturers](page:ind-rolling-stock), the result is a facility that reaches production sooner and performs as planned – with one organisation answerable for it.

blocks.heading: Machines at work in railway workshops
paragraphs: Our projects range from a single machine added to an existing shed to fleets of wheel lathes for a national railway. In every case the measure of success is the same: wheelsets restored accurately, on time, for years after handover.

The projects below are presented with the client's name, location and scope as far as we are able to publish them. For projects that are still in progress, see [Projects Under Execution](page:under-execution). To discuss a reference installation relevant to your fleet, [contact us](page:contact-us).

blocks.heading: Machines for high-frequency urban fleets
paragraphs: Metro and rapid transit trains run frequent services with short turnarounds. Their wheels wear quickly and must be restored without taking trains out of service for long. Underfloor wheel lathes, single or in tandem, are built for exactly that task.

Projects of this kind typically follow the full HYT process: engineering, manufacture at our works in Pune, site preparation, installation, commissioning and training. Completed projects are listed under [Executed Projects](page:executed-projects).

items.text: National Capital Region Transport Corporation has issued HYT a Letter of Acceptance for fully automatic CNC underfloor wheel lathes.
